request: Add flange with thickness of 0,5mm and width of 2mm that starts on the flat bottom surface. Do not fill the central part. Add four mounting holes with D=0,5mm which are spaced 0,6mm from outer edges of the flange

actions.operation: Create a flange feature (boss/extrude-type) starting from an existing face, with specified thickness and width, while leaving the central region open (annular flange / not a full fill).

parameters.direction: negative Z from the existing bottom face (outboard from the part)
parameters.profile_type: rectangular ring (outer rectangle offset outward; inner rectangle = existing pocket opening loop)

actions.relational_constraint: Flange starts on the flat bottom surface; central part must not be filled. Interpreting 'central part' as the existing open-bottom pocket opening: keep the inner rectangular opening fully open (no cap/plate). Flange width is measured outward from the current outer perimeter of the part.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: 'flat bottom surface' corresponds to the planar underside rim face (a rectangular annular face around the open-bottom pocket). 'Do not fill the central part' corresponds to preserving the existing inner rectangular opening of that bottom rim as a through-opening (do not create material across it).
steps: Select Section S1 bottom rim (underside frame) face_code 0000 (Brep FACE 11) as the sketch plane; set sketch normal pointing in -Z for the flange growth direction.

In the sketch on face_code 0000: Project/Convert the outer boundary edges of the part footprint (outer rectangle defined by the outer side faces: x=±1 from faces 0001/0003 and y=±3 from faces 0002/0004).
Offset the projected outer rectangle outward by 2.0 mm to create the flange outer perimeter (this defines the 'width of 2mm' as an outward extension beyond the existing outer edges).

Project/Convert the existing inner loop of face_code 0000 (the pocket opening perimeter) and use it as the inner contour of the flange so the central opening remains open (annular/ring extrusion). Do not offset this inner loop unless required for manufacturability; keep it coincident with the current pocket opening to satisfy 'Do not fill the central part.'

Create an Extrude/Boss (Join) of the ring region between the 2.0 mm-offset outer rectangle and the unchanged inner pocket-opening loop: extrusion distance = 0.5 mm, direction = -Z from face_code 0000. This creates new Section S4 (bottom mounting flange) while preserving the open central pocket.
Validate that the flange does not intersect/close the pocket (Section S3) opening; the inner contour must remain a through opening.

parameters.placement: one near each outer corner of the flange, symmetric about XZ and YZ midplanes
parameters.extent: Through All (cut through flange and body as applicable)

actions.target: the flange created in the previous action
actions.relational_constraint: Each hole center located such that it is offset 0,6mm from the two nearest outer edges of the flange (corner condition). Holes placed in four corners using symmetry (mirror/pattern) about the part midplanes. Hole axes normal to the flange bottom face (+Z direction cut).
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved assumptions: (1) The 'outer edges of the flange' are the outermost perimeter edges created by the 2.0 mm outward offset in Action 1. (2) The 4 holes are located at the four flange corners, each centered 0.6 mm inboard from both adjacent outer edges. (3) Hole depth is Through All to function as mounting holes.
steps: Select the newly created bottom face of the flange (Section S4) as the hole sketch plane (this face is parallel to face_code 0000 and offset by 0.5 mm in -Z). If the CAD system requires referencing an existing face: create an offset construction plane from face_code 0000 by -0.5 mm and sketch on that plane.
In the sketch: define the flange outer rectangle (use Project/Convert from the flange outer perimeter edges created in Action 1).

Create one circle of diameter 0.5 mm near one outer corner. Dimension its center 0.6 mm from the two adjacent outer flange edges (i.e., 0.6 mm from the X-outer edge and 0.6 mm from the Y-outer edge for that corner).
Mirror the circle about the model symmetry planes (YZ plane x=0 and XZ plane y=0) to obtain a total of 4 hole centers (one in each flange corner), maintaining identical 0.6 mm edge offsets.

Perform an Extrude Cut / Hole feature using the 4 circles: extent = Through All in +Z direction (or symmetric Through All) to ensure the mounting holes pass through the flange and the underlying solid where present.

Check that the holes do not break into the inner pocket opening (Section S3). Corner placement should remain in solid material due to the pocket being centered; if any intersection occurs, reduce flange width or shift hole inward, but keep the 0.6 mm offset from the flange outer edges as the governing constraint.

intention: Provide a mounting flange on the underside for fastening while keeping the central underside pocket/opening unobstructed.
Add four small mounting holes positioned by a controlled edge offset from the flange perimeter for consistent assembly alignment.
